shortDescription: Listens for specific messages on multiple sockets and manages port states

options.name: expected_messages
options.description: A list of messages the listener expects to receive.

options.name: log_file
options.description: Optional path to a file where every received message and significant events will be logged. Supports dynamic naming using server node and port information.

options.name: port
options.description: Port for the listener to start and receives messages on

options.name: response_message
options.description: The message to send back upon receiving an expected message.

options.name: server
options.description: A dict specifying server details where the socket listener is running.

options.name: timeout_seconds
options.description: The maximum time in seconds the listener should wait for all messages across all ports.
